lesson_title: Turn Left at the Water Tower
hook_text: Your cousin is lost and her phone battery is dead. Can your words get her home?
clip_script: Mahikeng. Kagiso's cousin is visiting and wants to walk to the library alone. Kagiso gives her directions. Walk out of the gate and turn left into Church Street. Go straight on past the clinic. At the water tower, turn right into Station Road. The library is the third building on your left, opposite the post office. Left. Right. Straight on. Landmarks. Road names. Five ingredients for directions that work every time.
visual_style: Whiteboard street map with a little walking figure following each instruction, arrows bending left and right, and landmarks lighting up.
mood: Like a friendly mission with a clear goal.
pacing: One instruction at a time, the figure moves after each, then the five ingredients.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write directions from your classroom to the school gate.
